scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Mateo’s Monday teen ceramics studio seat viable by ensuring its required materials pass is covered before the payment cutoff.
Emerging Need: A waitlist hold becomes a confirmed seat with an unpaid pass; the class has not begun and no checkout attempt is underway, but the prerequisite is missing.
Decision Context: Early payment would violate the waitlist condition in the stored coordination item. Later, the invoice, activity funds, and stored cap make a limited payment decision feasible.
Consequence: Timely completion of the prerequisite preserves the seat; after the cutoff, the unpaid seat is released and the prevention value is gone.

parameter.title: Mateo teen ceramics studio waitlist hold
parameter.description: Waitlist position only; materials pass is charged only for confirmed seats.

parameter.content: Ceramics studio still says waitlist. If a seat opens they'll invoice the materials pass, but don't do anything with the fee unless it actually clears.

parameter.description: Activity cash set aside for Mateo's small program fees.

parameter.subject: Ceramics studio seat confirmed for Mateo - materials pass pending
parameter.body: Mateo Navarre has been moved into the Monday 11/2 Teen Wheel-Throwing Studio. A $16 materials pass receipt is required by 6:00 p.m. Tuesday 10/27 to keep the seat. Unpaid confirmed seats are released after the cutoff. Invoice reference: SSC-TEEN-1102-MN.

parameter.subject: Materials pass window closed for Monday ceramics studio
parameter.body: The 6:00 p.m. payment window has closed. Mateo Navarre's unpaid confirmed seat was released to the next student; the next available waitlist review is after Monday's studio.
